title: [Subcontracting] Bug 648843: Align feature-handler references with CLEAN28
summary: Existing conditional-compilation guards around SubcFeatureFlagHandler references in the Subcontracting app and its test are aligned with the handler's CLEAN28 boundary and 28.0 obsoletion tag. This covers 425 guards around declarations, calls and the permission entry, plus 17 dependent checks of the cached SubcontractingEnabled variable.
key_points: 425 guards around SubcFeatureFlagHandler declarations, calls and the permission entry changed to the CLEAN28 boundary
17 checks of the cached SubcontractingEnabled variable now share that boundary to avoid unresolved references
Italian legacy-handler references stay under their existing CLEAN27 guards
Other CLEAN29 guards, obsoletion tags and schema boundaries are unchanged
